events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday on September 21, 2026.

angles.name: Iconic Voice
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that iconic swagger and unmistakable voice to the stage.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic song 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK in 1975.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: More than just a song, it's a timeless message. John Lennon's 'Imagine' saw its UK single release in 1975, and its hopeful vision still resonates today.

events.title: First iPod Unveiled
events.blurb: Apple first introduced the revolutionary iPod on October 23, 2001, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember life before this? The first iPod was unveiled on October 23, 2001, putting '1,000 songs in your pocket' and revolutionising personal music.

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks Global James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', which premiered in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's Global James Bond Day, celebrating over six decades of the world's most iconic secret agent.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday on October 9, 2026.

angles.name: Remembering a Visionary
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember John Lennon – a visionary artist whose music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The inimitable British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday on October 27, 2026.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy icon. Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese!

events.title: The Beatles 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: A Blank Canvas
angles.copy: More than just an album, it was a statement. The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped on November 22, 1968, a sprawling masterpiece that redefined rock.

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's Death
events.blurb: November 24, 2026, marks the anniversary of the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost a true showman. Remembering the unparalleled talent and stage presence of Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

events.title: The Beatles 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Game Changer
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history. The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965, showcasing a new depth and maturity.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's Death
events.blurb: December 8, 2026, marks the anniversary of the tragic death of music icon John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: A Legacy of Peace
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost a voice for peace and a musical genius. Remembering John Lennon and his enduring legacy.
